findings.issue: The REQUEST A QUOTE button still sits right on the top edge of the tinted trustBar band with no white space under it, because the plain hero's inner still has no bottom padding.
findings.reference: The competitor's plain title and lead (hero:plain) leave clear white space before the next module starts.
findings.fix: In template.css give .page-hero[data-variant="plain"] .page-hero__inner a bottom padding (e.g. padding-block: calc(var(--section-space) / 2)), so a tinted neighbour never starts right under the hero's button.

findings.issue: At desktop the hero button still ends only a few pixels above the tinted trustBar band, so it looks pushed into the band.
findings.reference: The competitor leaves an open white gap under its centred title and lead before the next module.
findings.fix: Same template change: give .page-hero[data-variant="plain"] .page-hero__inner a bottom padding.

findings.issue: The intro paragraphs still run about 90–96 characters a line ('Once you agree the price, standard sample development takes 10 to 15 days. To request a sample,'), above the ~70ch measure.
findings.reference: The competitor's lead under its title keeps to short lines, and treatment-practice holds running text to about 70ch.
findings.fix: In reference.css set max-width: 70ch on the intro's text (.block--intro .text-flow p, .block--intro .block__lead).

findings.issue: The open answer still runs across the whole right column at about 95–100 characters a line, so the long paragraph is hard to follow.
findings.reference: The competitor keeps running text in short lines, and treatment-practice holds running text to about 70ch.
findings.fix: In reference.css cap the answer's width (.block--faq .faq__item p { max-width: 70ch; }).

findings.issue: The +/− open/close marks beside each question are tiny, thin glyphs (about 8px) far off at the right edge, so it is hard to see that the questions open.
findings.reference: The competitor's interactive marks (the contact-card icons and black labels) are bold and plainly visible.
findings.fix: In reference.css enlarge and thicken the FAQ toggle mark (e.g. .block--faq .faq__item summary::after { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent-text); }).

findings.issue: The consent line still ends '…as described in the privacy policy. Privacy policy', repeating the link's words right after the sentence.
findings.reference: The competitor's form has no repeated text.
findings.fix: End the consent copy before the link (e.g. '…as described in our') or make 'privacy policy' inside the sentence the link.

findings.issue: The headings 'Contact details' and 'Send an enquiry' use sentence case, while the page's other section headings ('Frequently Asked Questions', 'What to Expect Once You Get in Touch') use title case.
findings.reference: The competitor sets all its contact-page headings in title case ('Contact Us', 'Have Questions?', 'Email Us').
findings.fix: Write the two headings in title case ('Contact Details', 'Send an Enquiry') in the page copy.
